traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Stenocereus (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.46 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 2 records in 1 source); trunks 0.46, branches 0.48. traits.note: The Flora of North America's account of Stenocereus, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): stigma lobes 5 to 15, white; the carpels are as many as the stigma lobes (Hamburg's Botany Online on the family, as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read).
